en.title: Resume

points: Coursework: Marketing Management, Economics and Business Mathematics, Business Statistics, Organizational Behaviour, International Business, Business Communication, Operations Management.
New-product research and launch communication: Researched ZUS Coffee launch content using consumer preferences, social feedback and competitor content, then distilled product messages for promotion.
Social content operations: Supported 50 Instagram posts through planning, shooting, editing, English copywriting, hashtags and promotional asset organization.

Channel coordination and review: Supported online launches and FamilyMart communication with assets, store information and schedules. Monitored performance weekly and completed 15+ content reviews to improve subsequent communication; the account gained 11k+ followers during the project period.

Market research and user insights: Researched teaching, lesson preparation and self-study needs among university users in mainland China and overseas. Classified 100+ community feedback items to identify recurring needs and usage barriers for product communication.

Product communication: Built the product WeChat content program from scratch and delivered 30+ guides, FAQs, tutorials and use cases focused on product value. Core-feature usage increased 30% during the period.
Market partnerships: Supported Southeast Asia AI education cooperation by clarifying needs and responsibilities and following up on agreement signing and project handoff.

Campaigns and materials: Coordinated university demonstrations and trials, prepared product demos, FAQs, teaching cases and course materials with product and business teams, and handled event flow and questions. Consolidated feedback into over 10 improvement suggestions for product updates and future pilots.
Coursework: Marketing Analytics, Consumer Behaviour, Marketing Research, Customer Analytics and CRM, B2B Marketing, New Product Marketing.

User insights and campaign planning: Collected feedback and conducted pricing surveys to understand needs, willingness to pay and price acceptance. Planned messages and touchpoints by user stage, independently designed selected acquisition campaigns, and supported promotion, product demonstrations and on-site execution at technology events.
Campaign performance monitoring: Built an AI-assisted operations dashboard to track promotion and conversion metrics, identify drop-off points and support performance reviews.

Brand content and creator collaboration: Turned user needs into product messages across 100+ WeChat, Xiaohongshu and community posts. Screened finance and AI creators by audience profile, relevance and engagement, and supported promotional content and launch tracking.

Channel promotion and review: Promoted across Xiaohongshu, WeChat, communities and offline events; tested titles, covers and content and reviewed channel spending. Registrations during the campaign rose 50% versus the previous week, while first-topic creation rate increased approximately 15% relatively.

skills: Marketing postgraduate with working English and experience in user insights, social content, product promotion and campaign execution.
Marketing: market research, competitor analysis, product messaging, social content, campaign planning, promotional materials and creator collaboration.
AI: assisted dashboard creation and data analysis; recurring work organized into SOPs, checklists and reusable templates.
Content: Xiaohongshu, Instagram and WeChat; Canva, CapCut, Figma (basic).
